# Repository instructions

This repository currently contains only a minimal README; no application code,
tests, or build tooling is present.

- Before making changes, inspect the current repository contents and follow any
  project-specific conventions that have since been added.
- Do not assume a framework, architecture, dependency manager, or test/build
  command that is not established by the repository.
- Keep changes focused on the user's request. Update the README or other
  documentation when behavior or setup instructions change.
- When adding code, use the smallest appropriate implementation and add focused
  tests if the repository has or gains a test setup.
- Run relevant checks documented by the project; if no checks are configured,
  state that rather than inventing a validation command.
